title: LandingViewportManifest
description: Canonical schema for the LandingPage single-page / external-portal sample corpus and its four responsive viewport classes. Cited by SMR-09 (LandingPage distillation) and SMR-12 (Responsive Viewport Lab). The manifest is emitted by LandingPage/scripts/seed-portal-samples.mjs and describes every sample's handle, pinned snapshot hash, and per-class budgets.

generator.description: Path of the deterministic generator that produced this manifest.

generated_at.description: Fixed stamp, so a re-run reproduces the corpus byte for byte.

hash_algorithm.description: Algorithm declared in every seeded row's g_time coordinate a.

viewportClass.description: The four responsive classes the corpus must cover.

handle.description: Stable sample handle under the urn:mcard:content:landing_sample namespace.

kind.description: inline = content held in the corpus; external = a page reached by URL.

url.description: Descriptive live URL for external samples; CI never fetches it.

fixture.description: Deterministic local fixture that stands in for the live origin (frameable, x-frame-options-deny, csp-frame-ancestors).

snapshot_hash.description: hex(H(content)) under hash_algorithm — the pinned CAS snapshot.

viewports.description: Per-class budgets this sample is engineered to satisfy.
